snippet.title: URCICUS - Official Release Trailer (OUT NOW)
snippet.description:
Buy here: https://platinaxo.itch.io/urcicus
Play the free demo: https://platinaxo.itch.io/urcicus-demo
Support me: https://ko-fi.com/peanutellaxo

URCICUS, a fast-paced circus theme platformer is out NOW. Playable on the Game Boy Color and the Analogue Pocket, help Veve fix her mistake and collect shards to seal the chaos she unleashed!
9 varied levels await, all with their own themes and gimmicks. 

You die in 1 hit to everything, but every new room is a checkpoint! Collect bells and tickets to unlock new characters and the bonus stage, respectively! Seal the demon back up for good!

Made with GBStudio.
Music in-game and trailer: https://www.youtube.com/@UCJ4y4YjK_BkRQBmh0jcZFGw
